profile.description:
Equine Assisted Interactions Centre, Life Coach & Author. A place where we celebrate the things that make us unique. 

The aim of Spirit Of The Phoenix is to create a space for an individual to be able to face their obstacles, find truth and happiness in who they are. By creating opportunities to assist the individual in their personal growth so they are able to fulfill  their life's purpose by celebrating their uniqueness.

[Established in 2011] Spirit of the Phoenix is a place where people come to celebrate their uniqueness; to explore disability as an asset and not a liability. We are an Equine Facilitated Interactions Centre, founded by Life Coach & Occupational Therapist and PATH qualified Hippotherapist Naomi Sharp in 2011. Learn more about Naomi's Qualifications Together, with the horses Buzz Lightyear, Scrumpy Jack & Edith we offer Equine Facilitated sessions in both Equine Assisted Learning and Equine Assisted Therapy. The aim of Spirit of the Phoenix is to create a space for an individual to be able to explore their obstacles and find truth and happiness in who they are. We provide the opportunity for individuals to interact with horses, and delve into personal obstacles and reconnect with their resilience. “Sometimes it’s the people no one imagines anything of who do the things that no one can imagine.” From the movie, The Imitation Game Contact us We help people from a range of experiences and diagnosis. Through participating in Equine Assisted Therapy and Equine Assisted Learning we create opportunities to assist the individual in their personal growth. Equine Assisted Interactions Equine Assisted Therapy Equine Assisted Learning Groups The process of using the horse environment to help an individual to explore their inner obstacles, and create new routines to support their new self image. pages.excerpt: Home Life Coaching Support Portal Bookshop Equine Assisted Interactions Course Contact Us The Team Equine Assisted Therapy Equine Assisted Learning Groups Centres in UK Newsletter - Publications and Peoples Experiences Videos Home Life Coaching Support Portal Bookshop Equine Assisted Interactions Equine Assisted Therapy Equine Assisted Learning Groups Course Contact Us Centres in UK The Team Newsletter - Publications and Peoples Experiences Videos spirit of the phoenix- About the team CONTACT US: 07596 900 835 [email protected] Visit our Facebook page patch adams Patch greets everyone at the door with a hello and hug, his gift is making people laugh and smile. In true Spirit Of The Phoenix style he also loves a cup of tea! causing mischief and running around in circles. Patch is 8 years old. Naomi Founder of Spirit of the Phoenix In 2007 Naomi was asked what she was going to do in her life she responded "help people with a disability working with horses". In 2011 her dream came true as she embarked on the journey of Spirit Of The Phoenix. As an Occupational Therapist, she has a passion for helping people to carryout activities that bring them happiness. Naomi has been around horses since she was 2 years old and has travelled watching different people work with horses from dressage, to a working stud and time at a wild horse sanctuary observing the herds. Buzz Lightyear Meet Buzz Lightyear he will take you to infinity and beyond with his happiness for life. He is a big believer in standing up for yourself and staying on the right path to your dreams. He is kind and gentle and is best friends with Matilda. He too is a big advocate of therapeutic grooming with his long flowing mane and loves to stand for hours being pampered. Buzz is 14 years old. Scrumpy Jack Scrumpy Jack is a true gentleman, he is 11 years old. He has a big cheeky personality and loves to be part of a group. He gives the best hugs and will always be up for playtime but is a sensitive man knowing when a person just needs unconditional love. Edith Miss Lady E, is 11 years old and nicknamed by everyone black beauty. Edith is a calming girl and loves food, she will wonder over to say hello. Edith has a bright personality playing with the toys, smiling and enjoys going out for a walk around the farm. Sarah Tucker- Speech and LAnguage Therapist MA.
